Populist left and progressives now leading the charge on “not another dollar” to Israel. This is an issue we should have been leading on all along, and now we’re there! Let’s go, everyone else put pressure on your incumbents to move to this position. Not another dollar!


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

The Iron Dom is important & saves lives.  Israel should be able to buy it on their own with a $45 defense billion budget. Israel is a first world country, and it can pay for the defensive systems it needs

Bringing our troops home would obviously be worth leaving the war for, on its own, but the icing on the cake would be watching Israel First freak the fuck out. And how hilarious it would be to see the guys who were kissing Trump's ass a minute ago turn around on a dime.

Trump is screwed no matter what now. If he continues the war and puts ground troops in, all the voters will hate him, including huge chunk of his own voters. If he doesn’t continue the war, establishment media will ravage him because they’ll be furious he didn’t listen to Israel.

Israel is now indistinguishable from the Taliban. They’re religious extremists who don’t value the lives of anyone not in their religion and destroy and desecrate anything related to other faiths. They also dug up Muslim and Christian graves in Gaza. We’re funding terrorists.


WULF (@DerWulf)

“Israeli Forces Bulldoze Saint George Statue in Christian Lebanese Village”

This might be first real test of political revolution against the establishment. If right-wing populists can’t defend on their home turf of Kentucky and lose the seat to Israel, then the polls are right and MAGA are just 85-95% cult followers of Trump. But I think Massie holds!

In @RepThomasMassie primary, we have pure test of mainstream media and billionaire money versus grassroots. Ideology and partisanship are largely removed as factors since it’s within same party. 
  
There’s only one main thing that separates them. One is willing to work for the donors and the other isn’t. One works for Israel and the other is a patriot.

This is a test of the free versus the brainwashed zombies. Can enough propaganda get the people of Kentucky to vote against America and in favo

If you tell the Iranians you might leave without reopening the Strait, then they have all the incentive to wait you out and offer nothing in return. Best deal is that we promise to leave in exchange for reopening Strait. But now, we’ve lost that leverage, too. Total incompetence.

Trump keeps saying that he’s going to obliterate Iran AND that he’s going to leave right away. Now, he’s saying he’s going to leave without reopening Strait of Hormuz. What? I’m all for leaving, but wouldn’t we at least negotiate to reopen it? He has no idea what he’s doing!

They popped champagne after this. Fascism has come full circle. But their Goebbels is not in Israel, it’s the American press. They don’t just whitewash their massacres and racism, they pretend the fascists are the victims. And the victims of their genocide are the aggressors.

Israeli government officials are sick fascists. It’s an unconscionable moral stain on our country to support Israeli regime. Now, they passed a law to hang Palestinians, that doesn’t apply to Jewish Israelis for the same crimes. It’s insane that our media pretends not to see it.


sarah (@sahouraxo)

Israel just passed a law to execute Palestinians.

Not metaphorically.
Not rhetorically.
Legally.

They bomb Palestinians.
Starve Palestinians.
Imprison Palestinians.
Now they want to legally execut

Can I get one other person in media or politics to ask this simple question - why is no one in Washington considering using Israeli ground troops instead of Americans? Why is using their troops not even an option? @megynkelly @TuckerCarlson @MizzWelch @RoKhanna @RepThomasMassie

This might be a stronger clap back than you’ve had against the war or your corrupt colleagues. But we don’t need any more silly beefs like this. You voted in favor of Iron Dome a couple of times. That’s ok, water under the bridge. You voted for IHRA definition of antisemitism, which is inexplicable and egregious.

Of course, sending any kind of weapons to Israel is worse than the speech you blocked, but it’s against all progressive beliefs to equate criticism of Israel with antisemitism. I know

I'm really worried about our guys. Our leaders think they're setting a trap, but they're not that bright. So, I'm super worried that we're walking into a trap. But it won't be the leaders who pay the price. It'll be the guys on the ground, if the administration is overconfident.

The way every neocon and Trump are constantly talking about Kharg Island makes you think that's not where they're going. But it's not like the Iranians are children. They know Trump loves to think he's faking people out. I'm afraid its our leaders who are unprepared.

Do you know how impossible it’ll be to find the uranium in the middle of a gigantic country (four times the size of Iraq and more mountainous than Afghanistan)? Israel sets purposely impossible standards, so that we can’t get out of these wars. They actually want regime change.

Trump told everyone to watch Mark Levin last night. Already, you’re a lost man if you’ve thrown your lot in with Levin. The most unlikable man in America. Levin then said on his show that we should go get the uranium with 2,000 (American) ground troops and that it’ll be easy!!

Now the talking point from Israel First is Trump never said no ground troops! Of course, we’re going to put in (American) troops! But don’t worry, only a small amount and it’ll be easy. The only person in the country stupid enough to believe that is Donald Trump.

Here’s the essence of a deal we could have anytime - we stop attacking Iran, they stop attacking us and our Gulf Coast allies, they open up the Strait and we come home. People will say, “But that leaves our beloved ally Israel to fight the war they started on their own.” Exactly!

Twelve US service members have been badly injured in a strike in Saudi Arabia. The Houthis have entered the war. They might be able to close up a passageway that will make oil prices even higher. This gigantic mess brought to you by our “special ally” Israel. Let’s come home!
